h2: Jaguar XK AJ-V8|Timing Chain Tensioner Issue?|
description: If your XK is a 2012-2014 X150-generation car with the 5.0L AJ133 engine, timing chain tensioner failure is the single most frequently reported issue by owners, based on independent analysis of over 2,500 owner reports. It's part of the same design flaw that led to a US class-action lawsuit covering this engine across multiple Jaguar and Land Rover models. Earlier X100-era 4.0/4.2L V8s have their own separate, well-established timing chain tensioner wear pattern.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: AJ26/AJ27 injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Jaguar specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes - both verified: AJ26/AJ27 widely documented with multiple TSBs; M156 pre-2012 established Jaguar specialist pattern.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras - just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
